race.comment: DUAL MASTERY (2) looks to be edging towards an overdue win, and his efforts this season have all been in town against better fields than what he meets here. He has a good gate, and Jaden Lloyd has been ridding well. On top for us. HANDSOME TRIUMPH (3) has improved since joining the local Steven Hardy stable. The step up from 1500m to 1640m will suit him for his peak run, and he should go close to winning this. JOSEPHINE OF TUFFY (7) has gone close to winning a race here this season, and she was ridden a lot more quietly early on last start, before battling on to finish fourth. She is down in trip, and if the tempo is genuine, she can run into the money. WINGEANDWIN (8) overcame a wide gate by working forward to secure a good spot early on, and then stuck on bravely to finish runner-up. She has been steadily improving with race experience, and should hold her form now. I'M ON FIRE (6) was not bad fresh up for his new trainer at Gatton just over 2 weeks ago. Include in all combos.
